title: SG-4.2.5 · Untrack the conflicted vitest cache and dedupe conflict-stage listings
summary: The vitest cache file results.json is tracked and in an unresolved merge conflict. The cleanup must untrack it and clear the conflicted index entry, and the listing parser must deduplicate conflict stage entries.
description: Context: game/frontend/src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts holds trackedNodeModulesPaths, parseGitLsFiles, checkTrackedFiles and untrackNodeModules, and scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts runs the cleanup. Desired behavior: a conflicted node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json is untracked with its conflict stages cleared, and a listing that repeats a path across stages 1-3 yields each path once. Why: stale conflict entries must not keep dependency or cache paths tracked or inflate the guard's report.
acceptance_criteria: Given a git listing containing stage 1, 2 and 3 entries for the same path, when parseGitLsFiles runs, then the path is returned exactly once.
Given a conflicted node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json, when untrackNodeModules runs with a fake git runner, then it issues a force cached removal for that path that clears the conflicted entry.
Given a mocked listing with conflict stage entries, when checkTrackedFiles runs, then each offending path is reported once.

in_scope: unit tests with a mocked listing and fake git runner
out_of_scope: Resolving merge conflicts in other files
preserve: Files stay on disk (git rm --cached only)

technical_constraints: Unit tests only; git is faked through the GitRunner type
No real git index changes in tests
definition_of_done: Both requirements have passing unit tests
